title: knowgov pre-load check report
description: What `python tools/preload_check.py -f json` prints (task-0045): per document under an instance's artefacts/<kind>/, the state its kind's linter left it in at the threshold, the linters that ran, and the exit code of the programme's gate contract. Form, not knowledge: the knowgov gate's report is gate-report.schema.json. The optional baseline block and each finding's held flag appear only with --baseline (task-0065); sha256 per file since task-0064. The optional layout block appears only with --layout (task-0115). Version 1; a change is additive or a new version.

scope.description: all: every file under artefacts/; changed: the files --changed or --since named

baseline.description: with --baseline: the earlier report compared against, and how many findings at or above the threshold it holds and how many are new

layout.description: with --layout (task-0115): tools/check_instance.py's problems on the same instance, for annotation; exit_code is check_instance.py's (1 when the layout does not hold) and leaves the report's own exit_code unchanged

kind.description: error, warning:<rule>, note, absent, unread, unmapped or unmatched

path.description: the file it concerns, relative to the instance; null when it names none

fails.description: true for a layout error, which breaks the layout

checks.description: step 4's checks (task-0217, decision-0018 point 1), each across the kinds it reads, after the kinds' own linters: ran, unchecked (it cannot run here, or the instance holds nothing it reads; why says which) or cannot_run (exit 2); version is pumllint's for the trace, null for the checks of this repository's own; findings counts those that landed on a row of this report

delta.description: with --previous (task-0216, decision-0018 point 5): what a re-lint changed against an earlier report, at the same tool versions only; each finding new, gone (a slip when its file's bytes changed) or kept, matched by file, tool, rule and message

kind.description: the folder under artefacts/; null outside it

tool.description: the linter that ran, or for an unchecked file the tool the programme's table names

sha256.description: the digest of the file's bytes as judged, for a file under a known kind (task-0064): the load records the verdict only on a version with these bytes

held.description: with --baseline: the baseline holds this finding

tool.description: the step-4 check that found it (task-0217): pumllint trace, glossary or dmn gaps; absent for the row's own linter
